feature: Captions only when you ask for them
summary: Opening a recording no longer listens to it. Captions are made when you ask: right click a clip or its sound, the timeline's + menu, Video > Add Captions, or the one button in the Captions section.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Walk: Scripts/playtest/captions-on-demand-walk.json.

try.do: Open a screen recording with somebody talking in it, press Command 2, and wait ten seconds.
Look at the Captions section: one Add Captions button and nothing else. No Captions track on the timeline.
Right click the clip on V1 and choose Add Captions.
Press Command Z, then click the + under the tracks and choose Captions.
Open a five minute recording and press Add Captions: a Captions row at the top of the tracks fills as it listens.
While it listens, scrub or play: the editor keeps working. Then press the x at the end of that row.

evaluate: Is Add Captions on the clip's right click where you would look for it first, the way Premiere has Transcribe?
Is the Listening row at the top of the tracks enough to tell you it is working, or should it also say so on the canvas?
The x keeps the words heard so far. Is that what you expect Cancel to do, or should it throw them away?
With captions already made, the same rows read Rewrite Captions. Is that the right word?
rough: The mock's empty state says 'No captions on this clip yet. Auto-generate a word-level track...' with an 'Auto-generate captions' button. The panel shows only the Add Captions button (the task asked for nothing else), so that sentence is left out and the button uses the task's words.
The language picker only appears once there are captions. A recording in another language is heard in English first, then you pick the language and press Rewrite.
Add Captions on a clip listens to the loudest sound in the document, not necessarily the clip you right clicked. With one recording that is always the same thing.
The x on the Listening row keeps what it heard so far (the Captions section's button reads Cancel and does the same).
